regulation_ref: What a customs declaration typically needs that trade documents do not carry, as encoded for this prototype; the reviewer is to confirm each entry against the current declaration form; not an official source

inputs.label: Customs House Agent licence / broker code of the declarant
Exemption notification or preferential-origin claim, if one is made
Bill of Entry number and date (assigned when the declaration is filed)
Permit number (assigned when the declaration is approved)
Importer and declarant identification numbers required by the destination's customs authority
Customs office or port of entry
Declaration number (assigned when the declaration is filed)
